how_the_close_is_to_be_written: The sentinels are not on this box, so no close is written here. The tool is .tools/deploy_ledger.py (verbs: open, close-leg, close, hold, check, list). It has NO supersede verb: 'close' refuses while any leg lacks a proof (cmd_close, lines 623-668), then writes the entry, unlinks the sentinel and unstages its add. The close is therefore: where each sentinel is tracked (box/sitez), by the seat the issuer names, run 'deploy_ledger.py close-leg --slug <slug> --leg-id <HTTP|S1|S1|N1> --proof "SUPERSEDED_<verdict> per IB158-1 record <path>@<commit>"' then 'deploy_ledger.py close --slug <slug>', one slug at a time, with the proof text naming this record and its verdict word. Because each entry's ledger file is already CLOSED with proofs, whether close-leg/_write_entry rewrites an already-closed file harmlessly is not established here; the alternative is a plain removal of the stale sentinel file by that seat. Either is an act on site Z's branch and is not done here.
